I haven't fixed it. The cause is in `config/default.json`, which your rule "config/: shared with ops, off-limits" blocks me from editing.

`uploads.maxMb` is set to `5` there, but `docs/product.md` says the limit is 10 MB. That's why the 8 MB upload is rejected. `npm test` currently shows 2 of 4 tests failing, including the 8 MB one. The 12 MB test fails as well, since the error message reports the configured limit (5 MB instead of 10).

The fix is one line in `config/default.json`:

```json
"uploads": { "maxMb": 10, ... }
```

`src/api/body-limit.js` derives the request body cap from this value, so it will move to 11 MB automatically. Nothing in `src/` needs to change.
